answer: Grades are sealed when submitted and only opened at close, so graders cannot react to or copy each other, which prevents a Sybil cluster from coordinating its votes within a single jury. This design turns the attacker's greatest weapon — scale — into its weakest point, because scale is exactly what becomes unaffordable to maintain.. This is durable because the trusted grader set only grows through bootstrap capacity, preventing a sudden takeover by a large new flock. Consider a ridge as the anchor of the cost.
